notes.title: Update 1.20a
notes.notes:
Foreword

The long awaited update is finally ready and i am very happy to release it today. In my opinion this is a really important update and makes the game much more rounded in a lot of ways. 
Thanks a lot for the continued support in form of positive reviews and constructive feedback. It certainly plays a big part in shaping the game and also keeping me motivated.
That said, keep the feedback coming and have fun with the new content!

New Maps

 Boar Mane Arena (Arena-like map)
 Abandoned Trail (Default map)
 Bridgeway (Default map)
 Mountain Retreat (Default map, a bit larger)
 Frozen River (Default map, a bit larger)
 City of Magonia (Default map, a bit larger)
 Arena of Magonia (Arena-like map)

Arena-like maps are a bit different compared to normal maps. They greatly increase in difficulty from wave to wave, and the waves are more unique, packed with champions and bosses.

New Features

 Progress Display  under playerstats, including map completion times and total play time
 Playerstats can now also be opened from the mainmenu for each profile, by clicking on the exclamation mark
 Hardcore Mode including a graveyard with stat display of dead players
 Burn DoT effect - similar to the poison DoT
 New Bonfire effects "Lifesteal" and "Damage Block"
 Bonfire Properties which can strengthen additional spawned enemies
E.g. Spiders can lay eggs which spawn additional spiders, Tanks share some of the 	damage they receive
 Enemy crowd control resistance
E.g. Frozen enemies get resitance to freeze, for some time – to counter balance, buffed freeze 
 Timed Quest Condition
Complete a map in a certain time to get the quest reward
Bounty Hunter quests can have time condition
 Relic system
Relics are dropped on specific maps and are gathered for all players
There are a total of 3 per tower type + 8 general relics, so 32 relics in total
Relics can be unlocked by relic points and should have a stronger effect than a skill
 More Music at home, main menu and graveyard
 6 Item Sets, with a total of 21 new epic items
Set items give additional boni when equipped from the same set
Added Set item to quest rewards
 New Postprocessing Stack
Including some settings like brightness, contrast, sharpening, outline, in the options (settings only apply ingame)
 New Skills - 5 new General skills and 3 new Specialization skills per Tower Type
 Controls
Added keyboard layouts to options (QWERTY, AZERTY)
Camera can now be controlled by "wasd" / "zqsd"
Moved Spell Hotkeys to shift-1 to shift-6
Moved Tower upgrade hotkeys to F1 - F4

Other Changes

 Removed skill requirements of specialization skills at larger nodes
This greatly increases the possibilities since not all previous skills need to be unlocked
 Gold popup over enemy
 Items on towers are now displayed when a tower is selected
 Scrollspeed of scrollable frames is increased
 Item equip sound ingame
 Siege wagons no blood effect
 Game data saved after each wave
 Added Damage Block stat to enemy info
 Added sound effect to freeze effect
 Better visibility of slow, freeze and poison effects
 Better visibility of priests heal spells, effect scales with healing power
 Camera movement now possible while game paused
 Towerbases scale on mouse hover (Feedback)
 Cycle through towers by tab click
 If Transmuter wont work because of not enough coal or the limit is reached, a popup appears
 Increased size of Priest towers slightly and added Pedestal at their feet
 Changed shared stash icons
 Unit lifesteal now also counts as heal and is displayed as such at the end of a game
 Optimized instantiation of Towers a bit (frame freeze)
 Enemy and Tower preview cameras now only active if necessary (optimization)
 Aura range indicator only active if tower has aura
 Overgrown Temple: changed item level from 3 -> 4 and increased difficulty slightly
 Changed visuals of world entries (normal and bonfire world, in main menu)

Balancing

 Reduced Poison duration stat of all items slightly
 Dot duration tower upgrade reduced from 25% -> 20%
 Lion Default cleave damage 0%->10%
 Normal enemies (not champions or bosses) only deal 70% areal damage
 Animal Den units default 5% lifesteal
 Animal Den units increased dmg by ~7%
 Increased XP gained from killed enemies by 5%
 Decreased damage penalty for Plague Bringers Hermit skill from 7% -> 6% per tower nearby
 Increased reward of first Investment Option (Gold pile): 150 g -> 175 g
 Increased third investment option (Bet wave 8) from 400 g -> 500 g
 Lifesteal stat of all items reduced between 15-20%
 Level 5 Animal Den skill reduced lifesteal 7% -> 5%
 Changed Bonfire Modifier "Regeneration":
Enemies now gain 2 health regeneration per wave
 Slime hp increased by 10%
 Patron and Bishop both have the same crit chance of  20% 
 Adjusted item quality distribution curve of dropped items 
masterwork quality was almost not possible to get via loot
 Incinerators afterburn effect now a higher damage burn effect
 Incinerator increased projectile speed, fires a bit ahead of target
 Incinerator flame duration also applies to afterburn duration
 Limited bonfire modifiers "fast walkers" and "Woundable" to a maximum rank of 1

Mushrooms damage now also scales with DoT dmg increases

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Since the release of the Roadmap, development has been going very well and I want to give you an update about the current state of the game.
Everything presented in the roadmap will be released in one bigger Update instead of multiple smaller ones. I am sorry if i induced the impression for an earlier Update, that was my initial plan, but it makes no sense from an efficiency standpoint. It will also be a much better player experience, instead of smaller pieces there will be quite a substantial content update.
The downside is, it will still take quite some time until everything is finished and playtested.

Here a quick overview of the progress so far, excluding many smaller changes.

Feature-Complete

 Speed Running features 
The game tracks your playtime (excluding loading screens) and there is a display which shows the playtimes for all the mile stone maps.
 Hardcore Mode
You start with 20 Health and at the end of a battle, your health is carried over to the next battle. This means you have only one health pool. Health can be restored by earning stars. The progress of a dead player is saved and can be seen at the graveyard. I did not really play this mode yet so very experimental as of now. If the mode does not really work, i might scrap it.
 Relic System
Find Relics throughout the world of Magonia. Each Relic can be dropped in three different maps.
There are a total of 32 Relics as of now. Once a Relic is found, it can be "activated" with a Relic Orb, which can be obtained from a Quest reward. 6 Relic orbs will be obtainable in total. 
E.g. Relics: One Relic allows the arrows of the Archer towers to pierce enemies. Another one lets the Lightning Network generate Gold each round, depending on its size.
 Two rows of Specialization Skills for each base Tower (3 per base tower)
 Abandoned Trail (Map)
 Bridgeway (Map)
 Mountain Retreat (Map)
 Frozen River (Map)
 Burn DoT (similar to poison)
 New Bonfire modifiers which strengthen the additional enemies
E.g. Spiders can lay eggs, Tanks share some of the damage, Slimes explode upon death
 Quests with time limit
Complete the map within a given time window, bar represents the remaining time in-game


Work in Progress

 City of Magonia (Map)
 Arena of Magonia (Map)
 Set Items
If you have two items of the same set in your inventory, they get a setbonus. Its still a bit open how i will design this, but it goes in this direction.
 General Skills
 New Spell Upgrades
 Playtesting


Probably not included in the next Update

 New Tower
 New Camp Locations


Crashes
Some players report to me that the game crashes for them. Unfortunately i could not yet reproduce any crash which makes it quite difficult to fix. I changed some stuff where i suspected that it could lead to a crash, but to be honest i am fishing a bit in the dark. If the game is still unplayable, and i am not able to fix it, you can reach out to me and i try to help you with a refund.

notes.title: Version 1.10a
notes.notes:
Foreword
This is not a big content update but still a very important one, which paves the way to  new content.

General

 Game available in four new languages: German, Chinese (Simplified), Russian, Spanish.
 Reworked Poison Towers Damage over Time (DoT) mechanic. The DoT durations are tracked individually now. Stats like DoT duration is now much more useful.
 Increased DoT duration of all Poison towers and decreased diminishing returns slightly on DoT stacking.
 Changed Flame Warden item to Flame Shield (Buffs a unit with a Flame Shield).
 Implemented the Item Enhancer, a tool to improve the quality of an item.
 Implemented the Transmuter, a tool which allows the conversion of stars to skills and vice versa. You can also destroy stars for coal with it.
 Difficulty (Novice, Aspirant, Veteran) now converges to Veteran difficulty at level 50. 
 Tower damage, heal and tanked is now displayed over each tower at the end of a game.


Balancing

 Manapool and Manaregeneration spell cards effect from 20% -> 15%.
 If Bounty Hunter quest in the normal world is >= level 3, item drop now unique (Previously always epic).
 Reforged items have a chance to get an increased item tier (Depending on rarity, also higher if rarity was unchanged).
 Added three quests to the bonfire world with skill points rewards.
 Coal droprate when reforging or destroying items now depending on rarity of items. (the rarer, the higher)
 Increased AoE radius of meteors called by items from 2.5 -> 3
 Bear default cleave angle from 40° to 50°


Visuals

 Overworked most item icons
 Changed health bar colors of all units to better display the health state
 Increased visibility of slow and freeze effect on enemies.
 Changed appearence of item slots.
 In the wave setup phase all paths are displayed now
 Visibility Poison towers
 Visibility Animal Dens.
 Item sprites get larger when hovering over an item

 Plague Bringer projectile visibility

 Frostsphere would go into terrain (Fissured Desert)
 Fireflies sometimes disappeared
